text:
vivian: morning async — quick standup (what I did / blockers / today)
what I did: rolled route-policy v2 canary to staging (20%). ran a short low-burst smoke run. saw intermittent 429s from the auth gateway.
blockers: can't reproduce locally; logs point to rate-limiter rejecting short concurrent bursts.
today: instrument rate-limiter, bump bucket window, and add extra metrics. will pause canary if trends worsen. pinging @sam for help.

sam: ok — thanks for the heads up. yesterday we saw a similar spike and it tracked to the token-bucket refactor in PR #482. can you drop the exact staging log lines and the smoke script args?

vivian: logs snippet: 
```
[auth-mlg-3] 2026-03-15T08:12:21Z 429 rate_limiter: bucket=svc_api, capacity=100, consumed=101, window_ms=50
[auth-mlg-4] 2026-03-15T08:12:21Z 429 rate_limiter: bucket=svc_api, capacity=100, consumed=102, window_ms=50
```
script: ./scripts/burst-smoke.sh --qps 120 --clients 5 --duration 30s

leigh: fyi I merged a tiny change to policy-evaluator last night (no routing changes expected) but I can double-check the matching logic. not blocking me.

omar: if window_ms is 50 that's pretty small for concurrent 10-20ms requests. we often see spiky 429s with short windows. try bumping to 200ms as an experiment.

vivian: applied temporary config bump in staging: token_bucket.window_ms = 200 via configmap.
ops-bot: configmap/apps/auth updated by vivian — rollout started :arrows_clockwise:

sam: nice. can you also emit rate_limiter.token_bucket.available and rate_limiter.overflows as metrics? add a retry counter too. PR with logs/metrics would help (link it to incident ticket).

vivian: adding gauges now, pushing PR 499 with log context and metrics. ETA ~2h.

leigh: I'll keep monitoring canary dashboards. no blockers here. if anything odd shows up I'll post screenshots.

omar: plan B: if we still get unexplained 429s after window bump, fallback to v1 policy for the affected route (quick rollback) to buy time. not ideal but keeps traffic healthy.

vivian: noted. I'll update runbook with rollback steps and notify owners.
sam: heads-up — if rollback happens, ping @katy for customer comms.

vivian: will do. updating thread as I make progress. :thumbsup:
